description: Current Spinnet 1.0.0 Host Service catalogue. IDs, entry points and authority are independent of package origin.

entry_points.call: A script calls the operation inside its invocation: spinnet.<id>(input), or requestHostService("<id>", input). Returns the result.
entry_points.command: A manifest Command with execution host names it in host_command; its input is the Action's configured input and the Command's fixed input. No helper starts.
entry_points.view_action: A page action or item action names it in perform with its input; the Host performs it on the user's click or key without a View Event.
entry_points.request: An answer to a gesture names it in operation: {perform, input}; the Host performs it after the answer commits (ADR 0018).
entry_points.answer: A member of the answer itself is this operation: toast, close.
entry_points.source: The Host performs it for a visible current page source (reference/sources.md), or a current Host-Fetched Section.

not_offered.reason: A Plugin's item in the menu bar would need a script kept alive to update it; Spinnet keeps no resident runtime (ADR 0004) and a helper lives only for a bounded invocation (ADR 0007). The Host Status Item lists Host-generated activities instead (ADR 0017)
It needs a script running while the Menu is idle (ADR 0004, ADR 0007)
A script on a timer runs when the user asked for nothing, outside any invocation the Host can bound and show
Handing a Plugin's operations to a model lets the model, not the user, decide what runs and with what data, which consent to a Capability cannot cover
It reaches pages, tabs and history in another App, which no Capability can disclose precisely enough to consent to

not_offered.area: Arbitrary file operations, including moving to the Trash
not_offered.reason: Reading, writing or deleting any path reaches far beyond what one Capability can disclose; opening a path, Plugin Storage and Host-owned tasks on reviewed profiles cover the probes
Apple Events go only through Reviewed App Interfaces the Host ships (ADR 0012)
Credential Uses place or sign with stored keys without the Plugin seeing them (ADR 0011); an OAuth flow would need its own design, and no probe needs it (#68 leaves Spotify OAuth out)

not_offered.area: A page stack with push, pop and pop-to-root
not_offered.reason: Page memory keeps the last pages by ID instead; page stacks and local dialogs are an accepted future direction of #68 with no current workload

not_offered.area: Plugin-bound keyboard shortcuts on page actions
not_offered.reason: The user decided (C5, C6) that pages bind no Plugin shortcuts; form/detail views keep theirs

not_offered.area: Per-Command preferences opened by the Plugin
not_offered.reason: A Menu Item's own configuration is the user's, edited in its Configuration Sheet; the Plugin opens only its Plugin Settings (host.showPluginSettings)
Plugin Storage holds up to Cache's default 10 MiB, and a Host-Fetched Section can cache its own answer
No workload; it would be an identity read of the user's Mac that no Capability covers

not_offered.area: Managing windows other than the focused one, and desktops
not_offered.reason: window acts on the focused window only; no probe needs a window list
Merged into host.toast: a toast without a view already shows near the pointer, and close with a toast closes the view first (decision N2)
